user.title: Grid energy meters
user.description: Pick cumulative counters (kWh) of energy taken from and fed into the grid. They were pre-filled from the Energy dashboard or guessed from sensor names, so check them. Use lifetime totals, not daily counters.

tariff.title: Seller and tariff
tariff.description: Seller sets the energy price, the distribution system operator (DSO) is fixed by your address.

data_description.dynamic: Energy price follows the day-ahead market (TGE Fixing I = PSE RCE) plus the seller's markup. Distribution is still charged by the tariff group.
data_description.sale_mode: Net-billing: RCE = 15-minute/hourly market price, RCEm = monthly average.
data_description.capacity_tier: The capacity fee (opłata mocowa) is a flat monthly charge chosen by yearly grid consumption.

prices.title: Prices

data.energy_peak: Energy price (day / morning peak / single zone)
data.energy_offpeak: Energy price (off-peak zone / G13 remaining hours)
data.dist_peak: Variable distribution charges (day / morning peak / single zone)
data.dist_offpeak: Variable distribution charges (off-peak zone / G13 remaining hours)

data_description.dist_peak: Sum of the variable network charge, quality charge, OZE and cogeneration charges per kWh.
data_description.fixed_monthly: Trade fee, fixed network charge, subscription, capacity and transitional charges, net.
data_description.offpeak_hours_summer: Only if your DSO moves the zones in summer (e.g. PGE: 15-17,22-6). Leave empty otherwise.
data_description.peak2_hours: G13: comma separated ranges, e.g. 16-21. Hours outside the afternoon peak and the off-peak hours count as the morning peak.
data_description.peak2_hours_summer: Only if the afternoon peak moves in summer (e.g. TAURON: 19-22). Leave empty otherwise.
data_description.excise: Akcyza per kWh, added to the energy price before VAT (0.005 PLN/kWh).
data_description.deposit_multiplier: Factor applied to the value of exported energy, if your settlement uses one.

error.same_entity: Import and export must be different sensors.
